name: ChapterPage - Sparse No Leads
description: The thinnest chapter that still has to render: a city and a region, no hero photo, no leads, no body, no links. It proves the centered-header fallback and that every optional block is genuinely optional rather than leaving reserved gaps. The fixture names DC and DMV Area, having previously named Japan — a chapter the site has since retired, which made it a trap for the next reader rather than a neutral example.
